name: curl-pipe-guard
title: Curl Pipe Guard
description: Before a curl | sh (or wget, or iwr | iex) one-liner is copied or run, shows the script's real host and flags plain http, raw IPs, shortened links, a host off the product's docs domain, sudo, -k/--insecure and missing checksum or -f; offers safer step-by-step commands.

meta.summary: Shows where a curl | sh install script really comes from and offers download, inspect and verify steps instead, before an untrusted script runs.
catches: Plain http:// and raw IP addresses
Link shorteners and hosts that aren't the product's own domain
No checksum and no -f (fail on HTTP errors)
A safer download, inspect, verify and run sequence to copy instead
limits: Parses the command text; it cannot tell whether the script itself is safe
Command forms it can't parse are flagged as unparsed rather than analysed
A matching domain can still serve a compromised script
a11y: Copy mode is a role="radiogroup" with roving tabIndex and arrow keys
HTTPS vs HTTP is shown with icons and text
Findings are written out in text
